metadata.description: Methodology content for PAL Dashboard charts - Real calculation logic extracted from code

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Total approved credit facilities across the portfolio, representing the bank's total credit capacity committed to clients.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Formula: SUM(Fac_Amount)

  • Single pass through portfolio data
  • Sums all Fac_Amount values
  • Includes all facility types (committed, uncommitted, revolvers, term loans)
  • NO exclusions applied at base level

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Fac_Amount - Facility amount (primary)
  • Facility_Amount - Alternative column name

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• NO hardcoded exclusions
  • Respects all user-selected filters (Region, Status, Product, etc.)
  • Includes all Management_Status values (DM + CM)

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: TFA represents the total approved credit facilities, driving business planning, capital allocation, and market share analysis. Growth indicates successful client acquisition and relationship deepening.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Total drawn/utilized amounts across the portfolio, representing actual credit exposure. Includes Direct + Contingent + PSE outstanding.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Formula: SUM(Total_OS)

  • Direct sum of Total_OS column
  • Total_OS already includes Direct + Contingent + PSE
  • Single pass optimization for performance

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content: • Total_OS - Pre-calculated total outstanding column

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• NO hardcoded exclusions
  • Includes all facility types and regions
  • Respects user-selected filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Represents actual credit exposure - funds deployed to clients. Critical for capital adequacy calculations, liquidity management, and utilization rate analysis.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Undrawn portion of committed facilities. Represents contingent liability that could be drawn at any time.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Formula: SUM(Total_Unused_Commitment)

  • Direct sum from pre-calculated column
  • Column already filters for committed facilities only

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content: • Total_Unused_Commitment - Pre-calculated unused committed amount

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Column inherently includes only committed facilities
  • Respects user-selected filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Critical for liquidity planning and capital allocation. Represents contingent funding obligation requiring liquidity reserves and capital buffers.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Undrawn portion of uncommitted facilities. Bank can refuse drawdowns, carrying lower capital requirements.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Formula: SUM(Total_Undrawn - Total_Unused_Commitment)

  • Calculated as residual: Total undrawn minus committed portion
  • Per-row calculation: (row.Total_Undrawn - row.Total_Unused_Commitment)
  • Aggregated across all facilities

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Total_Undrawn - Total undrawn amount (committed + uncommitted)
  • Total_Unused_Commitment - Committed undrawn portion

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Calculated field, no direct exclusions
  • Respects user-selected filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Lower regulatory capital requirements vs. committed facilities. Provides relationship flexibility without binding funding obligations.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Count of facilities and Credit Agreements (CAs) that have expired past their maturity/expiration date as of the reporting date.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Facilities Expired:

  • Count: COUNT(DISTINCT Facility_ID)
  • Filter: Maturity_Date < MAX(Report_Date)
  • ⚠️ NO DM EXCLUSION - Includes ALL Management_Status values

CAs Expired:

  • Count: COUNT(DISTINCT Relationship_ID)
  • Filter: CA_Expiration_Date < MAX(Report_Date)
  • 🔒 HARDCODED: Management_Status = 'CM' ONLY
  • 🌍 EMEA Special Rule: Also requires CA_Review = 'Yes'
  • Non-EMEA: All CM relationships counted

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Facility_ID - For unique facility count
  • Relationship_ID - For unique CA count
  • Maturity_Date - Facility maturity date
  • CA_Expiration_Date - Credit Agreement expiration
  • Management_Status - Used for CA filtering (CM only)
  • Region - For EMEA special logic
  • CA_Review - EMEA-specific filter
  • Report_Date - Baseline for comparison

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Facilities: NO Management_Status filter (includes DM + CM)
  • CAs: ONLY CM (Management_Status = 'CM')
  • EMEA CAs: Must have CA_Review = 'Yes'
  • Respects user-selected filters for display

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Expired facilities represent critical operational and credit risk requiring immediate remediation. High counts are regulatory red flags. EMEA's CA_Review requirement ensures focused tracking of reviewed agreements.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Year-to-date count and amount of newly funded facilities based on reporting month (not actual current date). Excludes PSE facilities.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Date Logic:

  • Uses Origination_Date OR Renewal_Date (whichever exists)
  • YTD = Jan 1 of reporting year → Latest Report_Date
  • ⚠️ Uses reporting month, NOT system current date

Filtering:

  • 🔒 HARDCODED EXCLUSION: PSE_non-PSE != 'PSE'
  • Always excludes PSE for commercial lending focus
  • Count: Raw facility count (not distinct by Facility_ID)
  • Amount: SUM(Fac_Amount)

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Origination_Date - Primary date field
  • Renewal_Date - Fallback if Origination_Date missing
  • PSE_non-PSE - For PSE exclusion
  • Facility_ID - For tracking unique facilities
  • Fac_Amount - Facility amount
  • Report_Date - Defines YTD range

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• 🔒 PSE ALWAYS EXCLUDED: PSE_non-PSE != 'PSE'
  • Only facilities with valid Origination_Date or Renewal_Date
  • Only facilities with valid Facility_ID
  • Respects user-selected filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Tracks actual business production. PSE exclusion provides clearer commercial lending activity view. YTD perspective tracks annual targets and YoY growth.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Month-to-date funded facilities. Same logic as YTD but for current reporting month only.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Date Logic:

  • Uses Origination_Date OR Renewal_Date
  • MTD = 1st of reporting month → Latest Report_Date
  • 🔒 HARDCODED EXCLUSION: PSE_non-PSE != 'PSE'

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Same columns as YTD
  • Origination_Date / Renewal_Date
  • PSE_non-PSE
  • Facility_ID

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• 🔒 PSE ALWAYS EXCLUDED
  • MTD time window only
  • Respects user filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Early monthly production indicator. Enables quick trend identification and timely corrections.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Count of facilities and CAs expiring or coming due in next 3 months from reporting date. Used for renewal pipeline tracking.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Date Range: MAX(Report_Date) to MAX(Report_Date) + 3 months

  • Charts/tables show facilities with Maturity_Date in this range
  • Grouped by month for trend visualization
  • Count may be raw or distinct depending on use case

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Maturity_Date - Facility maturity date
  • CA_Expiration_Date - CA expiration
  • Report_Date - Baseline date
  • Facility_ID / Relationship_ID

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Only facilities/CAs within 3-month window
  • May inherit Management_Status filters from display context
  • Respects user-selected filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Critical for relationship management and revenue protection. Enables proactive renewal planning and prevents client attrition.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Top N relationships ranked by selected amount type (TFA, Outstanding, etc.), with regional breakdown.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
User-Selectable Metrics:

  • TFA, Direct OS, Contingent OS, PSE OS, OSUC, Unused Commitment
  • SUM(selected_field) GROUP BY Relationship_Name
  • Sort: Descending by total amount
  • Top N: User-selectable (5, 10, 15, or 20)
  • Regional breakdown within each relationship

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Relationship_Name - Grouping key
  • Region - For breakdown
  • Selected amount field (varies by user choice)

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Only relationships with non-zero amounts
  • Respects user-selected filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Identifies key accounts requiring senior management attention. Informs concentration risk limits and cross-sell priorities.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Count and amount of newly approved facilities by credit classification. Tracks business origination momentum.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Uses First Approval Date:

  • Filter: Facility_First_Approval_Date in selected period
  • Grouped by Credit_Classification
  • Count: Number of facilities approved
  • Amount: SUM(Fac_Amount)

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Facility_First_Approval_Date
  • Credit_Classification
  • Fac_Amount

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Only facilities with valid approval dates
  • Respects user filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Tracks business origination momentum. Credit classification breakdown reveals risk profile of new business.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Facilities approved but not yet funded. Represents near-term balance sheet growth and revenue activation pipeline.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Identification:

  • May use Facility_ID LIKE 'PIPELINEFAC%'
  • OR: Has Facility_First_Approval_Date but no Facility_First_Funding_Date
  • Count and sum amounts

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Facility_ID
  • Facility_First_Approval_Date
  • Facility_First_Funding_Date

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Only approved but unfunded facilities
  • Respects user filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Enables liquidity planning and operational resource allocation. Large buildup may signal documentation bottlenecks.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Return on Tangible Common Equity across relationships/facilities. Shows capital efficiency and profitability.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content: Uses pre-calculated ROTCE column from data source. May aggregate by relationship or facility groupings.

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• ROTCE - Pre-calculated return percentage
  • Relationship_Name

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Only relationships with valid ROTCE data
  • Respects user filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Primary measure of shareholder value creation. Drives capital allocation and pricing adequacy decisions.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Past due and coming due covenants (loaded from separate Covenants_current.xlsx file). Tracks compliance obligations.

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Data Source: Separate covenant data file, not main portfolio

  • Past Due: Covenant review date < current date, grouped by aging (1-45, 46-60, 61-90, 90+ days)
  • Coming Due: Next 30 days from current date
  • Regional aggregation and filtering

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Covenant_Review_Date
  • Relationship_ID / Relationship_Name
  • Region
  • Underwriter

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Uses covenant-specific filters (Region, Underwriter, Product)
  • NOT standard portfolio filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Critical for regulatory compliance. Past due covenants require immediate action. Coming due enables proactive planning.

whatThisShows.title: What This Shows:
whatThisShows.content: Credit and Covenant Monitoring (CCM) activity distribution by region (loaded from CCM_current.xlsx and CCM_previous.xlsx).

calculationLogic.title: Calculation Logic:
calculationLogic.content:
Data Source: Separate CCM data files (current + previous month)

  • Count of CCM relationships by region
  • Variance tracking vs. previous period
  • Past due vs. current status breakdown

dataColumns.title: Data Columns Used:
dataColumns.content:
• Region
  • CCM_Status
  • Relationship_ID

exclusions.title: Exclusions & Filters:
exclusions.content:
• Separate data source from portfolio
  • Uses covenant-style filters

businessContext.title: Business Context:
businessContext.content: Regulatory requirement for ongoing credit assessment. Regional breakdowns help distribute workload and ensure adequate oversight.
